method_notes: Every capacity figure, square-metre figure, address and URL recorded below was read from a page that was actually fetched during this research pass; figures that appeared only in search-engine result summaries were deliberately NOT recorded, and those fields are left null with capacity_confidence CAPACITY_REVIEW_REQUIRED. Official first-party venue sites were preferred (GRADE_A); no third-party venue-directory figures were used as a capacity source. Calendar sources were only recorded where a fetched page listed actual forthcoming NAMED events; venues whose only public page was a 'hire our venue' / event-types marketing page were given zero calendar_sources and a no_public_calendar_reason. Operators were recorded only where a fetched page stated them, so several are null rather than guessed.
